import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem irrational_affine_quotient_rat_iff
    (x : ℝ) (a b c : ℚ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    Irrational (((x / (a : ℝ)) + (b : ℝ)) * (c : ℝ)) ↔ Irrational x := by
  have ha' : (a : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ha
  have hc' : (c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
  unfold Irrational
  have key : ((((x / (a : ℝ)) + (b : ℝ)) * (c : ℝ) ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ)) ↔
      (x ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ))) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
      refine ⟨(q / c - b) * a, ?_⟩
      have h1 : (↑((q / c - b) * a) : ℝ) = ((q : ℝ) / (c : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      have hx : x = ((q : ℝ) / (c : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) := by
        have hqc : (q : ℝ) / (c : ℝ) = x / (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) := by
          rw [hq, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hc']
        have hsub : (q : ℝ) / (c : ℝ) - (b : ℝ) = x / (a : ℝ) := by
          rw [hqc, add_sub_cancel_right]
        rw [hsub, div_mul_cancel₀ _ ha']
      calc (↑((q / c - b) * a) : ℝ)
          = ((q : ℝ) / (c : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)) * (a : ℝ) := h1
        _ = x := hx.symm
    · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
      refine ⟨(q / a + b) * c, ?_⟩
      have h1 : (↑((q / a + b) * c) : ℝ) = ((q : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (c : ℝ) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      calc (↑((q / a + b) * c) : ℝ)
          = ((q : ℝ) / (a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)) * (c : ℝ) := h1
        _ = ((x / (a : ℝ)) + (b : ℝ)) * (c : ℝ) := by rw [hq]
  exact not_congr key
